scope: Current Gallery breed catalogue, then named age/sex variants and shopkeeper. Finish and verify the snow-cat rest-pose baseline before expanding to other cats.
ownerDirection: 2026-10-13: neutral bind pose first; layers based on the same complete cat; feline skeletal control. Do not continue the rejected independently redesigned component assembly.
style: High-fidelity softly painted cozy storybook cat, believable feline anatomy, gently imperfect coat markings, tactile breed-appropriate fur or skin, warm neutral frontal daylight, restrained natural colours, no human costume, no lettering or watermark.
pose: Neutral four-legged standing bind pose, upright head without sideways roll or yaw, level eye baseline, untwisted neck and torso, natural grounded paws, tail visible to one side. Front-view baseline for facial and idle control. Not a human T-pose, not a tilted seated illustration, and not a walk/side-view asset.
method: Source-anchored layers from one neutral master. Retain the master's visible artwork and canvas coordinates where separated. Generate overlap, hidden attachments, clean underpainting and closed-state patches by reference editing that same source. Do not independently redesign visible components and align them afterwards. Separate extracted, generated-completion and mixed provenance. Never label reference edits as pixel-identical without verification.

parts.request: Tail, from hidden root to tip
Head fur underpainting, excluding ears and movable facial features

recording.legacyQueue: Preserve queue.json and all previous images/models; they describe the rejected v1 experiment, not completed v2 parts.
recording.completion: Recorded source candidates are not equivalent to validated artwork or a ready model.

rig.body: Use native .stretch group hierarchy and anatomical joint pivots for trunk, neck/head, four legs, ears and tail segments. Calibrate cats, not the upstream human pose detector.
rig.softMotion: Mesh deformation and native masks for breathing, blinking and local facial motion; not rigid whole-image rotation.
rig.rest: Head and paws stable during breathing; fixed ear/tail roots; no fabricated walking, side view or paper-flip turns.

gates: Static reassembly visually matches the selected master before motion
Texture, fur-flow, overlap and anatomical continuity
Fixed roots, paws and breath/head separation
Loop endpoints, scaled contact and static failure recovery
review.status: pending until genuinely verified; no automatic filled, modelReady or hall-cat replacement

git: PNG originals, masks, PSDs, revisions, queues, previews, native candidates and build outputs stay ignored under art-local. Only small production data/code enter Git.
